changes: 18.06 dB source headroom before mono output and every paraphonic sum contribution.
Move the private quantizer octave drawer detour to the common MIDI/audio argument push and preserve stock MIDI octave formatting.

Envelope: the engine applies AMP ATK/HOLD/REL from the DSP voice record's values (Part, locks, scene morph, LFOs; po_amp_snap before sy_ison's override) instead of the live lane (Part and locks only).
Pitch: on a synth track an LFO's depth on PTCH is divided by 5 at the existing depth-read detour (po_lfo3_depth), so it sweeps the stock range; PTCH knob/locks/scenes keep semitone units.
Scenes reach VOIC/CHRD; VOIC, CHRD and RATO take the nearer scene's value (crossfader midpoint) instead of the morph (po_scene_jump, po_ratio_word; LFO contribution to RATO kept).
publication: Proposed for owner review (Jan Kolkmeier): not released. Emulator measurements and a reported MKII test; chip timing and complete memory bounds unmeasured.
